text: {"lessons":["A single sale after a steep loss does not show that the timing was right; I should base future trades on the stock’s prospects and portfolio role, not just my average cost or recent decline.","My account has fallen substantially from its early value, so I should check whether my holdings remain appropriately diversified and whether any position creates too much risk.","I have rarely traded, and short-term fluctuations alone have not given me a clear reason to act; I should keep following a deliberate plan and review it periodically."]}
